selectedIdea.title: hope diamond mail
selectedIdea.description: Tell the diamond's journey through the mail, from the New York post office to the Smithsonian presentation.
selectedIdea.rationale: Tell the diamond's journey through the mail, from the New York post office to the Smithsonian presentation.
selectedIdea.evidence: Jeweler Harry Winston donated the Hope Diamond to the Smithsonian in 1958. The 45.5-carat gem was sent from New York's General Post Office on November 8 by registered first-class mail in a plain brown package. Postage cost $2.44 and registration cost $142.85. It reached the Smithsonian on November 10 and was presented in a ceremony attended by Postmaster General Arthur Summerfield.

synthesis.content:
Central thread
Tell the diamond's journey through the mail, from the New York post office to the Smithsonian presentation.

Evidence
Jeweler Harry Winston donated the Hope Diamond to the Smithsonian in 1958. The 45.5-carat gem was sent from New York's General Post Office on November 8 by registered first-class mail in a plain brown package. Postage cost $2.44 and registration cost $142.85. It reached the Smithsonian on November 10 and was presented in a ceremony attended by Postmaster General Arthur Summerfield.
